data.one_liner: Flutter client for Dialogflow API with authentication and intent detection
data.what_it_does: Provides a null‑safe wrapper around Dialogflow's REST API. Handles Google service‑account authentication, builds an authenticated HTTP client, and maps responses to Dart models. Lets you detect intents and retrieve text, rich messages, or audio responses.
use_when: You need to integrate Dialogflow conversational agents into a Flutter app
Cross‑platform support (Android, iOS, Web) is required
You want a ready‑made model layer and authentication helper
avoid_when: You need offline or on‑device NLU processing
You require support for platforms not yet stable (Windows, Linux, macOS)
You need a more generic HTTP client without Dialogflow‑specific abstractions
strengths: Null‑safety and web support out of the box
Convenient model classes generated with json_serializable
weaknesses: Limited to Dialogflow; not a general AI/ML client
Platform support for desktop is still experimental
Relies on googleapis_auth; may need extra setup for custom auth flows
data.setup_notes: Add dialog_flowtter to pubspec, include your Dialogflow service‑account JSON as an asset, and reference it in flutter assets. No native permissions required.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need raw HTTP calls and want full control over request/response handling without Dialogflow‑specific abstractions.
